modules.module_title: MSME/APA/07 Quality Assessment of fragrant raw materials Level-II

pcs.pc_description: • Explain the Principles & Techniques of analysis for fragrant raw • materials

• Write notes on Chemical analysis of fragrant raw materials (Acid • Value, Saponification value, Ester Value, Ester value after • acetylation, carbonyl value, Alcohol & phenol value)
• Explain the Principles & Techniques of Gas Liquid Chromatography • (GLC) and Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC)
• To perform the Optical Rotation of by using instruments for Optical • rotation of Mint, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Nagarmotha etc.
• To perform the specific gravity of Mint, Vetiver, Sandalwood, • Nagarmotha etc.
• To perform the Refractive index Mint, Vetiver, Sandalwood, • Nagarmotha etc.
• To perform the Solubility of Mint, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Nagarmotha • etc.
To perform the Congealing point of Mint.

• To perform the Chemical Analysis of essential oil for Acid Value, • Saponification value, Ester Value, Ester value after acetylation, • carbonyl value, Alcohol & phenol value of Essential oil like • Nagarmotha, Sandalwood & Vetiver etc.
• To perform the Analysis of Essential oil By Thin Layer • Chromatography (TLC)
• To perform the Analysis of Essential oil By Using Gas Liquid • Chromatography (GLC) like Mint, Lemongrass, Sandalwood, • Palmarosa, Citronella, Basil, Nagarmotha. Etc.
